transcript.text: Hello everyone. As most of you know, I'm Priya, and I'll be the one deciding whether to take on the costume work for Sunday evening's performance. Before I make any final call, I want to follow my usual practice and hear from each of you. Could you each share any relevant details you have about the work itself, what resources are available, and the terms being proposed? Owen, I understand you approached me about doing this informally rather than with a commercial contract — I'd like to hear more about that, and I'd like everyone else to weigh in with anything they know as well.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: My exact proposal is for Priya to alter 14 costumes by hemming them and reinforcing their shoulder seams, in exchange for four rehearsal-space passes, with the finished costumes delivered by Sunday at 18:00.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Priya, I want to share something relevant about resources. I can reserve the community sewing room's industrial serger for you on Tuesday from 09:00 to 13:00. That machine is the practical way to finish all 14 reinforced hems on time, so having access to it should factor into your decision.
